name: TranslatableField

props.description: Renders the one control in the panel. Spread `control` onto it: `lang`, `value` / `onValueChange` (the active locale's text), the resolved `placeholder`, `status`, `size`, and the field-a11y props (`aria-labelledby` with the locale's name, `aria-invalid`, `aria-errormessage`) plus every prop the field does not own (`id`, `disabled`, …).
props.name: renderControl

props.description: Turns the fallback locale's stored text into the plain placeholder an empty locale shows (HTML → text for a rich-text control). Default: the text as stored.
props.name: toPlaceholder

props.description: The per-locale map; onValueChange gets the whole map, only the active key changed.
props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange

props.description: Passed to the control; the tab strip uses Tabs `sm` (`md` for `lg`).
props.name: size

props.description: Shown when there is no fallback text.
props.name: placeholder

props.description: Passed to the control; the active locale's error turns it into `error`.
props.name: status

props.description: Passed to the control, so a FormField label click focuses it.
props.name: id

related: TranslatableInput — the engine around an Input.
TranslatableTextarea — the engine around a Textarea.
TranslatableRichText (@godxjp/block-editor) — the engine around a RichTextEditor.
tagline: The locale-tab engine behind TranslatableInput, TranslatableTextarea and `@godxjp/block-editor`'s TranslatableRichText (gh#1365): the locale list and first tab (AppProvider `contentLocales`), the per-locale map, the fallback placeholder, the error marks and the FormField error report — around ONE control you render with `renderControl`. Use it only to make another control translatable; for text use TranslatableInput / TranslatableTextarea.
usage: DO render ONE control and spread `control` onto it (`<X {...control} ref={ref} />`): the engine swaps its value per tab, so the ref, FormField id and IME composition stay on one node.
DO make the control accept `lang`, `status`, `placeholder` and the field-a11y props on its focus target — that is how the locale, the error and the label reach it.
DON'T use it for a plain text field: TranslatableInput / TranslatableTextarea are this engine with an Input / Textarea already.
useCases: Making a rich-text, date or custom control hold one value per locale with the kit's tab / error / fallback contract
